main.language_tooltip: Select GUI display language (loaded from lang/*.json).
main.tutorial:
Welcome to DeepCreamPy!

If you're new to DCP, please read the README.
This program does nothing without the proper setup of your images.

Report any bugs you encounter to me on Github or Twitter @deeppomf.
main.use_tta_tooltip: Average 4 horizontal-flip and small-shift views for higher PEPSI accuracy.
main.clean_input_dirs: Clean up input directories after decensoring
main.mask_editor_tooltip: Open interactive editor to mask and decensor an image directly.
main.cancel_tooltip: Cancel the currently running decensoring job.
main.initial_progress_message:
After you prepared your images, click on the decensor button once to begin decensoring.
Please be patient.
Decensoring will take time.
main.log_editor_started: Decensoring from Mask Editor has begun!

anima.prompt_tooltip: Optional auxiliary positive prompt. Leave blank to preserve the original art style.
anima.negative_prompt_tooltip: Editable negative prompt. Clear to run without negative terms.
anima.tail_cfg_tooltip: Run the final N% of denoising steps with CFG=1.0 to speed up inference (0% disables; e.g. 20% skips CFG on the last 20% of steps).
anima.fp8_tooltip: Store DiT linear weights in float8_e4m3fn and compute in BF16/FP16 to cut VRAM in half and avoid block offloading on 8GB GPUs (auto-enabled on <=10.5 GiB GPUs).
anima.cache_prompt_tooltip: Cache encoded prompt embeddings in CPU RAM to skip Qwen3 re-encoding across variations, batch images, or retries with the same prompt.

models.anima_tokenizers_missing: Anima offline tokenizers not found under {path}.
models.anima_available: Anima (Base + 4ch Inpaint LLLite) is available in Bar censor mode (GPU only).
